# orchestration_answer_tool

> Relay a user's answer to a paused workflow stage.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_answer_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Relay a user's answer to a paused workflow stage. Call this after the user
answers a question that a stage agent asked via orchestration_question_tool.

The stage agent will be re-invoked with the question and answer so it can
continue its work.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_stage_execution_id` | integer | yes | The stage execution that asked the question. |
| `answer` | string | yes | The user's answer to the pending question. |
